correctness.rationale: The proof correctly identifies 2r U with the Hamming ball B_R, R=min(2r,d). For every nonzero character support S, the injection from odd-weight ball points into points with odd S-intersection gives the strong Walsh bound \hat 1_B<=E-O, hence the affine majorant used after Fourier inversion. The combinatorial injection O<=dE then converts that bound to E times the B_1 mass. The even-parity subgroup indicator is nonnegative positive definite and has denominator one and numerator E. The bundled exact verifier checks every character for d<=10,r<=6, but the all-d proof is analytic.
